invite.unreachableBody: A phone cannot accept connections from the Internet on its own, so the person you invite would have no way to answer. A relay fixes that: a machine with a public Internet address that passes connections through to your phone.
invite.unreachableTitle: Your phone needs a relay first
invite.workingFound: Setting up the strand. On some phones this takes up to a minute.

profile.machinesHint: How you are reachable, and what acts for you
profile.privateNote: This never leaves your phone and is never sent to anyone.

relay.pinned: That last part names one exact machine. If anything else answers instead, your phone will refuse it — so you will always be talking to this one.

settings.notifyLimit: This decides what the app tells you. Whether anything can reach a sleeping phone depends on something of yours being awake.

viewer.savedNote: It is in your own library now, outside this app.
viewer.unsupported: Nothing on this phone can display this. You can still keep it, or open it elsewhere.
